reviews.title: Subs are SCAM operation
reviews.text: I bought initial 3-yr (+2 free mos) sub on 6/11/2020 ; renewed for 2 more yrs (+2 free mos) on 8/4/2023 ; renewed for 2 more yrs (+2 free mos) on 10/11/2025 ; but then got billed 1 yr EARLY on 10/11/2026 and was told sub renewals are actually for only *1* year, despite showing Support the renewal email from 10/11/2025 reflecting next billing date would be *12/18/2027*.  They refunded the 10/11/2026 charge, but that resulted in the sub being cancelled, and "there's nothing else that can be done now".  So despite their OWN email saying I should have 1+ more year, they doubled down and didn’t make things right. Am awaiting management feedback, which I'm expecting will be the same boilerplate "policy", but we'll see if they manifest any integrity...

reviews.title: Reconnection issues
reviews.text: It might be because my phone had a massive data leak, which caused my string of passwords to be extorted, but I paid for 2 years of vpn use and it’s always disconnecting and reconnecting. If I paid for 2 years of vpn use, I don’t want to see that they’ll be a potential risk of my data being leaked if I’m hooked onto a server. That’s the whole reason why I bought 2 years of vpn servers so that I wouldn’t risk my data being leaked, to remain protected and being exposed by my actual location. All of the servers I’ve been connected to like Germany and Italy aaaallll say that there’s a potential of data being leaked and to disconnect, that’s not the service I bought for. I’ve documented and have been monitoring everything though. Even switching protocols it does not work. If I bought service of VPN server use, why would my location and data sttiiillllll be leaked?

reviews.title: This is by far the WORST VPN I have ever used.
reviews.text:
CyberGhost is completely unreliable and works maybe 10% of the time on a good day. It is marketed as being compatible with macOS, but after a year and a half of restarting, uninstalling, reinstalling, force quitting, reopening, and repeating this endless cycle over and over again, I genuinely wish I had canceled my subscription on day one.

Eventually, after having cyberghost for over a year and endured HOURS of troubleshooting with customer support, I was finally told this today:

“We do have an issue for Mac devices where the VPN application is not responding upon launch. Rest assured that we can still provide workarounds for it.”

So let me get this straight:

Why is this product marketed as Mac-compatible?

Why is this a known issue?

And why did it take over a year and a half of frustration for anyone to admit it?

If a VPN requires constant “workarounds” just to open, then it doesn’t work. Period.

The name CyberGhost is fitting because this software barely exists in any functional sense. Save yourself the wasted time, money, and sanity. This is not the VPN for anyone, especially Mac users
